# Media Encoding

## Summary
The codec and rate facts shared by audio and video files.

## Shape
Rates travel as `QuantityField` (`frameRate` in fps, `sampleRate` in Hz, `bitrate` in bps) so the
unit is carried rather than assumed, and the field's own formatting adds the separators —
bitrates read in the thousands and sample rates in the tens of thousands. `channelMode` is a
`CodedValueField` over `channel-mode`. One field serves both media kinds: `audioCodec` and
`videoCodec` are separate so a video with sound fills both.

## Example
```ts
import { MediaEncodingField } from 'https://cardstack.com/base/file-formats/metadata-fields';

@field metadata = contains(MediaEncodingField);
```
